_comment: The movement-register (shape E) source entry, kept OUT of sources.json on purpose: the golden run in tests/test_statement_golden.py asserts a hand-computed maximum for every account it names, and a register states no balance, so it has no maximum to compute. Copy this entry into a workspace sources.json to run the reader. See README.md.

sources.notes: Yields movements and an estimate basis, never a maximum value: the file states no balance of any kind. `currency` is MANDATORY here — the register prints amounts but never names the account's currency, so a default would label rubles as dollars.
